data.body: Verify-parity sweep evidence, Nov 20 2026. The 300 s pytest-timeout expiries occurred only in runs that overlapped about 8 or more concurrent -n 4 make verify suites (Nov 19 21:09 to Nov 20 ~06:30, before the 3-run verify-slot cap): 14 to 20 expiries per run across 8 logs, 137 of them blocked in a git subprocess. The 5 complete slot-capped unsandboxed runs (Nov 20, load ~30) had 0 expiries at 300 s. A same-host A/B at load 17-21 of the git-heaviest modules from those logs (test_import_batching, test_engine_comparison, test_audit_retention_cap, test_fetch_common_dir_coordination, test_repo_snapshot, test_epic_bug_screen_4b54) passed both inside and outside the agent sandbox, slowest call 23.86 s, so the sandbox itself does not slow git (git start ~15 ms both ways). Conclusion for this ticket: the trigger observed in these logs is host oversubscription beyond the slot cap; the 0.5 s-per-start shim reduction in this ticket's AC remains a valid cost reduction but was not worked by the sweep.
